messages:
Noah P: Noticed a spike in SCIM deprovisioning errors after the RBAC update this morning. ~45 fails in the last 8m. Suspect an attribute strip.
Ivy K: Which attribute and which IdP/region?
Noah P: IdP: GlobalCorpIdP, region: us-east-1. Error from scim-runner: 
```
ERROR scim: missing required attribute 'org_id' for deprovision request
request_id=bb3c7f
```
Sam W: We recently tightened RBAC forward rules for service principals to remove some idp-internal attrs. That could explain it. Did the RBAC change include GlobalCorpIdP mapping?
Noah P: Yes, rule set 'idp-forward-restrict' went live at 09:02 UTC. Proxy logs show: 
```
INFO idp-proxy: attr_filter applied -> dropped attrs: [org_id, entitlements_internal]
WARN idp-proxy: downstream svc scim-runner expects org_id
```
Ivy K: Oof. Also FYI I rotated the KMS envelope key for idp-proxy yesterday but did a staggered rollout; some proxy nodes still used old key material. Could be two concurrent issues if the proxy retries changed envelope behavior.
sec-bot: Incident INC-4230 opened: SCIM deprovision failures after RBAC attr filter (us-east-1).
Sam W: Immediate mitigation: relax idp-forward-restrict to allow org_id for principals with kind=service and issuer=GlobalCorp. Can we patch that to canary?
Noah P: Patching canary now to two nodes in us-east-1.
ops-bot: roll/canary idp-rbac -> us-east-1 -> 2 nodes started by Noah P
Noah P: Canary applied. Requeueing a couple failed jobs.
ops-bot: scim-job 77234 retried by Noah P
Noah P: scim-job succeeded. Error rate falling.
Ivy K: Follow-ups: (1) add unit test verifying org_id preserved for scim consumers in role-mapper tests, (2) audit KMS-rekey rollout for proxy nodes to ensure no mixed key state during critical RBAC changes, (3) add alert if dropped-attr count > 10 in 5m.
Sam W: I'll own the role-mapper test and the alert. Ivy, can you post KMS rollout diffs to the incident so we can confirm no permission drift?
Ivy K: Will do, posting KMS change log and rollout timeline to INC-4230. The rotation did not change key policy.
Noah P: Thanks. Closing this thread; keeping incident open until tests+audit complete.
